raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "3.0.1"
  # Reuse these exact patterns in the owning output and runtime exclusions.
  python_files: "**/site-packages/**"
  devel_files: "${{ 'Library/' if win else '' }}{include/**,lib/cmake/**,lib/pkgconfig/**,lib/*.a,lib/*.lib,share/pkgconfig/**,share/doc/**,share/man/**,dev/**,bin/*.pdb}"

recipe:
  name: usd-exchange-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse/usd-exchange/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4e0a8b387aea521ceac3a3e07da740a74e2a2a15a9dc490295fffff48a389e7c
  patches:
    - use-pxr-targets.patch
    - macos-build.patch
    - remove-dev-tools.patch
    - disable-werror.patch
    - namespace-alias.patch
    - upstream-cpp-tests.patch
    - macos-typeinfo-visibility.patch

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  # Build all artifacts together, against the same Python and OpenUSD ABI.
  - staging:
      name: usd-exchange-build
    build:
      # Remove generated host-dependency bytecode before caching the install.
      # Package bytecode is regenerated from the output's own Python sources.
      script:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - bash "${RECIPE_DIR}/build.sh"
            - cmake -P "${RECIPE_DIR}/clean_bytecode.cmake"
            - cmake -DUSDEX_PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ version }} -P "${RECIPE_DIR}/install_python_metadata.cmake"
        - if: win
          then:
            - call "%RECIPE_DIR%\build.bat"
            - if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
            - cmake -P "%RECIPE_DIR%\clean_bytecode.cmake"
            - cmake -DUSDEX_PACKAGE_VERSION=${{ version }} -P "%RECIPE_DIR%\install_python_metadata.cmake"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - python
      host:
        - openusd
        - python
        - pybind11
        - pybind11-abi
        - tbb-devel
        - doctest
        - cxxopts

  - package:
      name: libusd-exchange
    inherit: usd-exchange-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overlinking_behavior: error
      # Catch-all: new installed files stay here unless assigned to Python/devel.
      files:
        include:
          - "**"
        exclude:
          - "${{ python_files }}"
          - "${{ devel_files }}"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - openusd
        - python
        - if: win
          then: libpython
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - pybind11-abi
      run:
        # OpenUSD links Python into DLLs on Windows; Unix shared libraries use
        # dynamic lookup, with libpython linked only into executable consumers.
        # https://github.com/PixarAnimationStudios/OpenUSD/blob/v26.08/cmake/defaults/Packages.cmake#L69-L76
        - if: win
          then: python
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libusd-exchange', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - ${{ 'usdex_core.dll' if win else 'usdex_core' }}
            - ${{ 'usdex_rtx.dll' if win else 'usdex_rtx' }}
          files:
            not_exists:
              - "${{ python_files }}"
              - "${{ devel_files }}"
              - ${{ 'Library/' if win else '' }}bin/test_usdex_core*

  - package:
      name: libusd-exchange-devel
    inherit: usd-exchange-build
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - "${{ devel_files }}"
        # Python owns its whole directory, including any future static helpers.
        exclude:
          - "${{ python_files }}"
    requirements:
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - pybind11-abi
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libusd-exchange', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libusd-exchange', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - usdex/core/Core.h
            - usdex/rtx/MaterialAlgo.h
          files:
            exists:
              - ${{ 'Library/' if win else '' }}lib/cmake/usdex/usdex-config.cmake
              - ${{ 'Library/' if win else '' }}lib/cmake/usd-exchange/usd-exchange-config.cmake
            not_exists:
              - "${{ python_files }}"
              - ${{ 'Library/bin/usdex_*.dll' if win else 'lib/libusdex_*.so*' }}
              - lib/libusdex_*.dylib
              - ${{ 'Library/' if win else '' }}dev/**
      - script:
          - cmake-package-check usdex --targets usdex::core usdex::rtx
          - cmake-package-check usd-exchange --targets usdex::core usdex::rtx
          # Match the SDK deployment target; compiler activation may default to macOS 10.9.
          - cmake -S test-consumer -B consumer-build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ${{ '-DCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=' ~ c_stdlib_version if osx else '' }}
          - cmake --build consumer-build --config Release
          - ctest --test-dir consumer-build -C Release --output-on-failure
        files:
          recipe:
            - test-consumer/
        requirements:
          run:
            - cmake-package-check
            - ninja
            - python
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}

  - package:
      name: usd-exchange
    inherit: usd-exchange-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overlinking_behavior: error
      files:
        - "${{ python_files }}"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - python
        - if: win
          then: libpython
        - openusd
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libusd-exchange', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libusd-exchange', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          site_packages:
            - usdex/core/__init__.py
            - usdex/rtx/__init__.py
            - usdex/test/__init__.py
            - usd_exchange-${{ version }}.dist-info/METADATA
            - usd_exchange-${{ version }}.dist-info/INSTALLER
          files:
            not_exists:
              - ${{ 'Library/' if win else '' }}include/usdex/**
              - ${{ 'Library/' if win else '' }}lib/cmake/**
              - ${{ 'Library/' if win else '' }}dev/**
      - python:
          imports:
            - usdex.core
            - usdex.rtx
      - script:
          - python -W error::RuntimeWarning -c "import usdex.core; import usdex.rtx"
          - python check_pip_metadata.py ${{ version }}
        files:
          recipe:
            - check_pip_metadata.py
        requirements:
          run:
            - pip
      - files:
          source:
            - CHANGELOG.md
            - source/core/tests/unittest/testCore.py
            - source/core/tests/unittest/testPxr.py
        script:
          - python -m unittest discover -v -s source/core/tests/unittest -p testCore.py
          - python -m unittest discover -v -s source/core/tests/unittest -p testPxr.py
